name: Kyonyuu Hitozuma 3P Saimin ~Saimin de Netorasete Itadakimasu!~
original_name: 巨乳人妻3P催眠 ～催眠で寝取らせていただきます！～
source: The protagonist is obsessed with married women as he believes they are superior in every way - experienced in bed, confident, and loved by their partners. Despite lacking the ability to pursue them aggressively, he dreams of being with them intimately. One night, he gets drunk and reveals his sexual cravings at a brothel, where he is given a book on hypnotism. Upon reading it, he finds himself in possession of the power to hypnotize people and sets his sights on the married women he has been fixated on, particularly his landlord, boss, and a teacher who reside near him. With his new-found power, he manipulates them into having sex with him and plans to do so with even more married women. His lust shows no sign of abating.
translation: 主人公迷恋人妻，因为他认为人妻各方面都更优秀：床上经验丰富、自信，而且被伴侣爱着。尽管缺乏主动追求她们的能力，他仍梦想和她们亲密相处。某晚，他在妓院喝醉，透露自己的性欲望，得到了一本催眠术书。读完后，他发现自己拥有催眠他人的力量，于是盯上了那些一直令他着迷的人妻，尤其是住在附近的房东、上司和教师。他利用新获得的力量操纵她们与自己发生关系，并计划对更多人妻做同样的事。他的欲望没有消退迹象。
